content.text:
**Finding submitted: deviation (high severity, assignment).**

- **What's there:** § 10.3 (p0063) is a bare "binding upon successors and assigns" clause. It says nothing about who may assign, on what consent standard, or how change of control is treated.
- **Gaps vs. preferred position:** no express right for Deerskin to assign to an affiliate or to an M&A successor; no restriction on HDI assigning (including to one of our competitors); no confirmation that our change of control is not a deemed assignment.
- **Mitigating check:** I reviewed the term/termination provisions (§ 4.1–4.2) and searched the full document — there is no change-of-control trigger and no HDI re-pricing or termination right tied to our ownership, so this is not a walk-away item.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** one sentence inserted after § 10.3 giving us the affiliate/successor carve-out, requiring our consent (not unreasonably withheld, never to a competitor) for HDI assignments, and confirming our change of control is neither an assignment nor a basis for HDI to terminate, suspend, re-price or modify.
- **Fallback offered in the comment:** mutual successor assignment on written notice, with consent for other assignments not unreasonably withheld.
